stories.title: Blue Origin rocket explosion could set back NASA's plans to put astronauts on the moon
stories.summary: Engineers at Jeff Bezos' space company Blue Origin are trying to figure out why their massive New Glenn rocket exploded on its launch pad Thursday night.

stories.title: Rescuers are racing against time to reach 7 men trapped in a cave in Laos
stories.summary: In Laos, rescue efforts are underway to reach seven men who have been trapped inside a cave for over a week.

stories.title: Over a thousand Palestinians from Gaza held in Israeli detention without charge
stories.summary: A controversial law allows Israel to hold Palestinians in prison without charge or trial. Israel says it's a necessary for security, but rights groups say it leaves detainees in a legal limbo.

stories.title: Boston's Brazilian residents prepare to cheer on their home country in World Cup
stories.summary: Massachusetts has one of the largest Brazilian populations in the U.S. And all across the state, Brazilians are gearing up to watch their homeland's national team compete in the World Cup.

stories.title: Strategies Americans are using for eating and shopping as food prices skyrocket
stories.summary: In the NPR series "What's Eating America," reporter Joe Hernandez examined how Americans across are adapting to high food prices and the strategies they use to cover them.

stories.title: 20 years since its release, Al Gore talks about the evolution of 'An Inconvenient Truth'
stories.summary: On the 20th anniversary of the release of his documentary 'An Inconvenient Truth,' Former Vice President Al Gore talks about how his mission to align policy makers across the aisle to work together for climate solutions has evolved.
